The resulting sharp profile gives a one-variable upper bound for J_4, and an exact square-difference identity proves its global maximum at t=sqrt(2)-1. The explicit rescaled pair satisfies the quadratic normalization and attains both branches. The bundled exact checker replays all critical algebraic identities.

value.rationale: The regular octagon is a standard non-Hilbert benchmark for geometric constants and has ordinary James constant sqrt(2). Determining the newly introduced quadratic-normalized James constant exactly supplies a natural missing benchmark and exhibits a genuine strict separation J_4>J through an exact structural smoothness lemma, rather than a routine substitution or arbitrary finite slice.
